scenario.name: GB200 NVL72 supplier-resolved ODM and component assembly
scenario.notes: Illustrative supplier-resolved assembly reconciliation. NVIDIA topology is hash-pinned; all ODM and component throughput, yield, qualification, allocation, and demand inputs are synthetic.

platform.name: NVIDIA DGX GB200 NVL72
platform.customer: Selected global DGX GB200 demand scope

accelerator_packages_per_compute_tray.methodology: NVIDIA reports four Blackwell GPUs in each GB200 compute tray.
accelerator_packages_per_compute_tray.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA rack BOM reports four accelerator packages per compute tray.
accelerator_packages_per_compute_tray.falsifying_evidence: A current DGX GB200 rack BOM reports a different accelerator-package count per tray.

compute_trays_per_rack.methodology: NVIDIA reports eighteen compute trays in each DGX GB200 NVL72 rack.
compute_trays_per_rack.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA rack inventory reports eighteen compute trays.
compute_trays_per_rack.falsifying_evidence: A current DGX GB200 rack inventory reports a different tray count.

rack_demand.methodology: Illustrative quarterly rack demand used only to exercise supply sufficiency and shadow-capacity logic.
rack_demand.confirming_evidence: Customer purchase orders and allocation ledgers support the same quarter and platform demand range.
rack_demand.falsifying_evidence: Dated orders, cancellations, or allocation records place demand outside the range.

platform.notes: The topology applies to NVIDIA DGX GB200 NVL72. Partner variants require separate BOMs.

odms.name: Illustrative ODM scope A
odms.tray_capacity_scope: One synthetic non-overlapping GB200-compatible compute-tray line scope for 2026-Q3.

compute_tray_capacity.methodology: Illustrative gross compute-tray starts for one declared ODM scope; not actual supplier throughput.
compute_tray_capacity.confirming_evidence: Line-level starts, station cycle times, shifts, and WIP records support the range.
compute_tray_capacity.falsifying_evidence: Verified line output or serialized tray receipts fall outside the range.

compute_tray_effective_yield.methodology: Illustrative post-assembly and functional-test tray yield.
compute_tray_effective_yield.confirming_evidence: First-pass yield, rework, scrap, and acceptance records support the range.
compute_tray_effective_yield.falsifying_evidence: Factory quality data show materially different sellable yield.

compute_tray_platform_qualified_share.methodology: Illustrative share of good trays qualified for the selected GB200 rack scope.
compute_tray_platform_qualified_share.confirming_evidence: Qualification lots and accepted configuration records support the share.
compute_tray_platform_qualified_share.falsifying_evidence: Qualification or configuration records imply a different share.

compute_tray_customer_allocation_share.methodology: Illustrative customer allocation after platform qualification.
compute_tray_customer_allocation_share.confirming_evidence: Allocation ledgers and serialized shipment destinations support the share.
compute_tray_customer_allocation_share.falsifying_evidence: Customer routing records show a materially different allocation.

odms.rack_capacity_scope: One synthetic non-overlapping GB200-compatible rack-integration and factory-test scope for 2026-Q3.

rack_integration_capacity.methodology: Illustrative gross rack-integration starts for the declared ODM scope.
rack_integration_capacity.confirming_evidence: Rack-station cycle time, shifts, burn-in slots, and WIP support the range.
rack_integration_capacity.falsifying_evidence: Verified integrated-rack output falls outside the range.

rack_integration_effective_yield.methodology: Illustrative rack integration and factory-test completion yield.
rack_integration_effective_yield.confirming_evidence: Rack bring-up, rework, and acceptance records support the range.
rack_integration_effective_yield.falsifying_evidence: Factory test records show materially different completion yield.

rack_platform_qualified_share.methodology: Illustrative share of completed racks passing the selected platform configuration gate.
rack_platform_qualified_share.confirming_evidence: Configuration and qualification records support the share.
rack_platform_qualified_share.falsifying_evidence: Factory acceptance records imply a different qualification share.

rack_customer_allocation_share.methodology: Illustrative selected-customer allocation of qualified rack output.
rack_customer_allocation_share.confirming_evidence: Serialized rack allocation and shipment ledgers support the share.
rack_customer_allocation_share.falsifying_evidence: Allocation or shipment records show a materially different share.

odms.notes: Generic supplier label avoids attributing the synthetic values to a real ODM.

components.name: ConnectX-7 400G NICs
components.capacity_scope: Synthetic non-overlapping customer-addressable ConnectX-7 pool for this platform and quarter.

capacity.methodology: Illustrative quarterly component input, not actual output.
capacity.confirming_evidence: Supplier sellable output and allocation records support the range.
capacity.falsifying_evidence: Verified output or allocations fall outside the range.

effective_yield.confirming_evidence: Final-test and RMA data support the range.
effective_yield.falsifying_evidence: Quality data show a different yield.

platform_qualified_share.confirming_evidence: Qualified SKU records support the share.

units_per_rack.methodology: Eighteen trays multiplied by four ConnectX-7 NICs per tray.
units_per_rack.confirming_evidence: A current rack BOM supports seventy-two NICs.
units_per_rack.falsifying_evidence: A current rack BOM reports another NIC count.

components.notes: Retimer and NIC silicon should be separated when a component-level board BOM is available.

capacity.confirming_evidence: Supplier and integrator output supports the range.
capacity.falsifying_evidence: Verified output falls outside the range.

effective_yield.confirming_evidence: Acceptance and leak-test data support the range.

units_per_rack.falsifying_evidence: The rack design requires a different count or splits the set into independent pools.

components.notes: Facility-side CDUs and heat rejection remain deployment constraints.

coverage.methodology: Defines each complete-rack output as having passed one local ODM compute-tray and rack-integration flow and having consumed every declared server- and rack-stage component pool. The declaration prevents those same constraints from being applied again downstream; it does not estimate real capacity.
coverage.confirming_evidence: ODM routing, serialized BOM issue, WIP, qualification, and finished-rack records show that the output definition includes every declared resource before factory release.
coverage.falsifying_evidence: Any declared component remains customer- or site-installed after the modeled output point, or the source capacities describe pre-material theoretical slots.
coverage.notes: Synthetic scope declaration. Factory qualification, logistics, site installation, facility-side cooling, transformers, and backup power remain separate.
